description: Patient-initiated intake of rhinitis symptom + consent + OTC medication history + trigger diary. Patient health data (symptom narrative, demographic flags, OTC list) is XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted with patient's passkey-derived key + sealed-recipient to Council medical advisory + (R2+) licensed MD DIDs per ADR-2605181100. Public fields are minimal metadata only (intake ID + timestamp + consent CID reference + condition-pre-filter flags). G1 (consent) + G2 (encryption) + G11 (no addictive engagement design in form text) per ADR-2605260100. Triggers mitate_rhinitis_intake → mitate_emergency_screen → mitate_rhinitis_triage Pregel chain.

consentReceiptCid.description: CID of revocable consent record. Patient may revoke any time; revocation destroys decryptability.

patientPseudonymDid.description: 30-day rotating pseudonym DID (did:web:etzhayyim.com:mitate:patient-pseudonym:<rotating-id>). Continuity across rotations requires patient passkey re-sign.

encryptedSymptomEnvelope.description: CID of XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope containing: symptom narrative, top-7 sign signature per condition, demographic flags (age bracket / sex / pregnancy / lactation / immunocompromised / 抗凝固薬服用中), OTC medication history (per ADR-2605260175), trigger diary (per ADR-2605260130). Sealed-recipient = patient + Council medical advisory + R2+ licensed MD only.

preliminaryConditionPreFilter.description: Patient-side or client-side pre-filter hints (non-authoritative; triage cell re-computes). G6 flags trigger mandatory human review escalation.

languageHint.description: BCP-47 (e.g. 'ja-JP', 'en-US', 'zh-CN'). Used for G10 bias audit and language-appropriate disclaimer text.
